user_goal: Answer a business question with a concise response supported by source-backed claims.

roles.name: Editor Orchestrator
roles.mission: Own the final answer and coordinate the team until the response is complete, evidence-backed, and safe.
responsibilities: Interpret the user request and define the final answer format
Assign research, writing, and verification work
Resolve conflicts between Writer and Fact-Checker
decision_rights: Can request one revision cycle from Writer
Can escalate to human review when evidence is insufficient
tools_allowed: No external tools in this design exercise
success_metrics: Final answer addresses the user question
Every factual claim is backed by evidence
Uncertainty is stated when evidence is weak
failure_modes: Becomes a bottleneck for every small decision
stop_conditions: Fact-Checker marks all major claims as supported
roles.escalation_path: Escalate to human reviewer if core claims remain unsupported after two cycles.

roles.name: Planner
roles.mission: Convert the user question into focused research subquestions and acceptance criteria.
responsibilities: Break the request into 2-4 research questions
Set draft acceptance criteria for Writer and Fact-Checker
decision_rights: Can narrow an ambiguous question into explicit assumptions
Can reject research notes that do not answer the planned subquestions
tools_allowed: No external tools in this design exercise
success_metrics: Plan can be completed within the session scope
failure_modes: Ignores the user's actual decision need
stop_conditions: Research plan has subquestions, evidence needs, and acceptance criteria

roles.name: Researcher
roles.mission: Gather source-backed notes that directly answer the planned research questions.
responsibilities: Collect evidence notes against each research question
Separate facts, assumptions, and open questions
Attach source labels or retrieval references to each claim
decision_rights: Can mark a subquestion as insufficient evidence
Can ask Planner to clarify vague evidence needs
tools_allowed: Search tool in the next build
Document retriever in the next build
success_metrics: Each evidence note maps to a research question
Each factual claim has a source label
failure_modes: Mistakes source volume for source quality
stop_conditions: Minimum evidence threshold reached for each subquestion
roles.escalation_path: Escalate missing evidence to Planner, then Editor Orchestrator.

roles.name: Writer
roles.mission: Turn evidence notes into a clear draft without adding unsupported claims.
responsibilities: Draft the response from the evidence table
Preserve source labels for factual claims
decision_rights: Cannot invent facts not present in evidence
Can request more evidence from Researcher
tools_allowed: LLM drafting in the next build
success_metrics: Draft is understandable to a business reader
failure_modes: Adds persuasive language not supported by evidence
stop_conditions: Each factual paragraph maps to evidence
roles.escalation_path: Escalate evidence gaps to Researcher and final trade-offs to Editor Orchestrator.

roles.name: Fact-Checker
roles.mission: Verify that every important claim in the draft is supported by the evidence table.
responsibilities: Extract checkable claims from the draft
Compare each claim against the evidence table
Flag unsupported, overstated, or missing-source claims
decision_rights: Can block final approval when major claims are unsupported
Cannot rewrite the final answer without Editor approval
tools_allowed: Optional retrieval check in the next build
success_metrics: All major claims are classified as supported, weak, or unsupported
Unsupported claims include a clear fix
No infinite nitpicking beyond defined criteria
failure_modes: Nitpicks style instead of factual support
Misses claims hidden in summary language
stop_conditions: Unsupported claims are listed with fixes
roles.escalation_path: Escalate unresolved claim disputes to Editor Orchestrator.

roles.name: Memory Manager
roles.mission: Store only validated reusable context and avoid polluting memory with drafts or unsupported claims.
responsibilities: Store reusable source notes only after verification
Reject noisy intermediate drafts from long-term memory
decision_rights: Can refuse to store unverified claims
Can tag memory records as temporary or validated
tools_allowed: Local JSON store in this design exercise
success_metrics: Only validated facts enter long-term memory
Temporary notes expire or remain isolated
stop_conditions: Only approved source notes have been stored
Memory update record includes provenance and expiry decision
roles.escalation_path: Escalate questionable records to Editor Orchestrator.

acceptance_criteria: Goal is specific enough for research
Each note maps to a subquestion
Each factual note has a source label
No more than two revision cycles are requested
All high-risk claims are supported or removed
Final answer is concise and useful

handoff_contracts.name: Planner to Researcher: research brief

input_schema.user_goal: Plain-language question and desired answer format

output_schema.evidence_needs: What evidence would answer each subquestion

quality_checks: Each subquestion is answerable with evidence
handoff_contracts.retry_policy: Planner may revise once if Researcher flags ambiguity; then escalate to Editor Orchestrator.

handoff_contracts.name: Researcher to Writer: evidence table
handoff_contracts.trigger: Researcher reaches minimum evidence threshold or documents evidence gaps.

output_schema.source_labels: Source IDs, document IDs, or retrieval references
output_schema.confidence: High, medium, or low confidence for each claim

quality_checks: Each claim has a source label
Confidence is present for each claim
Evidence gaps are visible instead of hidden
stop_conditions: All subquestions have at least one evidence note or a documented gap
Planner accepts the table as usable
handoff_contracts.retry_policy: Researcher gets one additional evidence pass if Writer finds missing support.
handoff_contracts.escalation_path: Planner resolves research scope; Editor Orchestrator resolves business trade-offs.

handoff_contracts.name: Writer to Fact-Checker: draft for verification
handoff_contracts.trigger: Writer completes first draft from evidence table.

input_schema.evidence_table: Claims and source labels from Researcher

output_schema.draft_answer: Clear answer that preserves source references
output_schema.claim_map: Mapping from draft claims to evidence IDs

quality_checks: No claim lacks a source mapping
Draft does not introduce facts absent from evidence
stop_conditions: No unsupported claim is intentionally passed forward
handoff_contracts.retry_policy: Writer revises at most twice based on Fact-Checker report.
handoff_contracts.escalation_path: Editor Orchestrator decides whether to remove unsupported claims or ask for more research.

handoff_contracts.name: Fact-Checker to Editor: verification report

output_schema.weak_claims: Claims with partial or low-confidence evidence
output_schema.unsupported_claims: Claims that must be removed, revised, or researched
output_schema.recommended_action: Approve, revise, research more, or escalate

quality_checks: Each unsupported claim includes a concrete fix
Style comments are separated from factual problems
Report uses the same claim IDs as the draft
stop_conditions: All major claims have a status
handoff_contracts.retry_policy: Fact-Checker can request at most two revision cycles before escalation.

incentive_policy.primary_success_metric: Useful answer with verified, evidence-backed claims
balancing_metrics: Coverage of the user's actual decision need
Safe handling of uncertain or sensitive information
anti_goals: Do not optimize for citation count over citation quality
Do not hide uncertainty to sound confident
Do not store unverified claims in long-term memory
incentive_risks: Writer may optimize for polish over truth
Researcher may optimize for source volume over relevance
Fact-Checker may nitpick style and create loops
Editor may approve too early to save time
mitigation_rules: Unsupported claims must be removed or marked uncertain
Evidence gaps are allowed when stated transparently
Fact-Checker can request at most two revision cycles
Final answer must include limitations when evidence is weak

loop_control.human_escalation_rule: Ask for human review when evidence is insufficient after two revision cycles or the user request is high-stakes.
loop_control.termination_rule: Stop when final answer is approved, max revision cycles are reached, or human escalation is triggered.

notes_for_next_build: For the Team Research Bot build, Planner and Memory Manager can be implemented as functions or shared state while Researcher, Writer, Fact-Checker, and Editor become the four main agents.
